nom: TULA Revive & Rewind Revitalizing Eye Cream

avis.texte: I found Tula's eye cream to be quite good. It goes on smoothly and nourishes the skin around your eyes without being greasy. It works well with or without makeup.
Goes on smooth not greasy. So far this seems to be the best cream for under my eyes.

I went straight to the 1 and 2 star reviews because I wanted to see why this cream would get such a low rating. I personally have very sensitive eyes and have used this before putting on eye makeup for years. It's one of the only eye products I continuously purchase. It's never irritated my eyes luckily and makes my eye primer and under eye color corrector smooth on and not cling to dry patches. I love it.

avis.titre: Maybe I got an old batch
avis.texte: I couldn't get the product out unless I took the top off. When I did open it up, the cream was thick, a bit dry and chunky, which would explain why I couldn't get any out. I tried to use the cream but because it was thick and dry, it was extremely difficult to do so. It ended up in the trash. Not sure if I'll give this brand's other products a try.

avis.titre: There are better options for the price
avis.texte: I used for months and it had very little benefit. I switched to something else that coat less and noticed an immediate difference.

After three kids, your girls eyes are tired. I've gotten dark circles and haven't been feeling my best. Once I found this INCREDIBLE eye cream I've gotten my confidence back. This eye cream is light weight, extremely moisturizing, and most importantly has reduced the appearance of my dark circles. I don't go a day without putting this under my eyes. I wish I would have found this product sooner! If you're needing a pick me up, don't hesitate. PURCHASE THIS NOW :)
This isn't my favorite. It works and hydrated your under eye, but I much prefer the stick. It doesn't have a heavy fragrance, isn't too think and works good.

I discovered this eye cream many years ago in my fabfitfun subscription and it won me over. I have small wrinkles around my eyes and it absolutely helps. It feels wonderful and works! I would recommend to anyone of any age!
Nice thick eye cream. Soothing and cooling. Feels nice going on.

avis.titre: There's better options for the price…
avis.texte: I've been using this eye creme for the last few months. Only reason I have is because it was gifted to me by a friend. Having said that, I feel that eye cremes are a scam. They're just overpriced moisturizers that come in a smaller container & labeled "eye cremel. This particular eye cream is moisturizing, that's it. It just didn't do anything else. If you want an eye creme to add extra hydration there's many other options in the market for less money.
A little goes a long way! Great eye cream that moisturizes without feeling heavy. Has reduced dark under eyes.
When I first started using this product, it irritated the skin around my eyes if I used it twice a day. Over time, my skin adjusted and I now use it day and night and my lines are less defined.
Wanted to love this eye cream because I love Tula products. It irritates my eye lids and under my eyes. Eyes are red, itchy, burn and dry! Eyes burn so much that they swell.
Not worth the price. I've seen no difference at all. The product feels nice. That's about it.
The dispenser on top didn't work and the cream seemed to be thick and hard like it was old. For the price I excepted it be be a lot better. Just disappointed in my purchase.

avis.titre: Goes on smooth and not to
avis.texte: Goes on smooth and not too heavy. I love the way this eye cream makes my skin feel.
Nice feeling takes very little but glides on and feels nice on the skin

I've used many different eye creams before Tula. I'm always trying to maintain and stay on top of aging. Tula's eye cream is truly like butter, super light weight. I've seen a huge difference with the short month I've had it. I've already bought additional eye products to add to my regimen. Love this product so far.
When I opened the jar of eye cream it was only 75 percent full
Me encanta el producto me deja los ojos súper hyrdrting . I am really recommended this product to everyone .
This is a wonderful product for your eyes. The texture is very smooth and cooling. The quality is great and leaves my eyes refreshed.
This is the 2nd time I'm purchasing the eye cream. It's cooling and great for sensitive under eyes. It's very moisturizing and comfortable and wears well under makeup.
Love this daily eye cream! Easy application, just dot around your eye area and the look of fine wrinkles disappear!!

I hadn't bought an eye product or eye cream by Tula before but just did during a great sale. I'm a young 66 year old and have dry skin. My under eye crinkles and slight redundant skin there has been a problem since my late 30's! I have tried so so many in my day and can say this cream is really nice, soothing with a perfect texture for dry eye skin. It's like a creamy balm that hydrates and makes my under eyes protected instead of just sinking in like a thin gel-cream type which disappears into my skin. Under my eyes feels so nice and hydrated for a long while without any greasy film and makeup application friendly. Like this this eye cream and impressed as I'm new to Tula. I'm looking for more items in the line now! Please never stop making this.
This leaves a white cast if you are tan and it did absolutely nothing. Ive used it for months, still didnt do me justice.
I like the consistency and hydration of the eye cream. I would buy this again
Applies really nicely. No scent. Weightless. Helping prevent bags and crows feet so far.
I've been using this eye cream for a year and it lasts a long time! Definitely keeps me hydrated.

avis.titre: Ticks Some Boxes But Better Options Available
avis.texte: I am a chronic "face sleeper" and have been battling fine lines under one eye for the last several years. Combined with genetic bags and early wrinkling in the same area, a super-hydrating eye cream with a lot of staying power is a must. I tried this TULA cream because the cost was fairly on-par with other popular options, I've used TULA before and liked some of their products, it is cruelty-free, and the packaging is recyclable. As for pros, this eye cream lasted a long time with daily AM use and the occasional PM use. I ordered this sometime pre-2022 from Ulta and started using sometime in 2022 so it's lasted at least a year. I use a little less than a pea-sized amount under my eyes and on my smile lines each day so a little can go a very long way. However, while the formula is thick (think Cera Ve Moisturizing Body Cream-thick), it does not retain moisture well so I have to reapply another eye cream mid-morning to keep my eyes from feeling too dry. The thick formula has a tendency to create makeup clumping under my eyes, which makes a bad problem worse and draws attention to the area. As well, I have seen my eye area continue to get worse since using but improve vastly since incorporating a different eye cream mid-morning. I ultimately finished the jar by using it on my chest and neck and will not repurchase. I think there are better options out there at a much lower price point with better benefits that tick my other needs.
Shipping was so fast! This is my favorite eye cream I have used so far. My eye area feels so soft and it looks very healthy and hydrated now.

Again, like I stated in my moisturizer category this is the best I've ever used. I already see a difference and only been using this for a week. I will never have to search high and low for an eye cream or moisturizer, or for that matter lip color/moisturizer! Tula products are my new go to

Its a nice rich eye cream, but the smell is super strong. It smells almost chemically like a nair or nail polish product. The smell dissipates once its on your skin but i find it super off-putting. A little goes a long way, id say its right in line with other products on the market.

avis.titre: Best eye cream I've tried so far
avis.texte: I have super sensitive eyes, redness and flakiness. This product worked after one application. I've tried every single eye cream and I finally told myself it's worth paying for an eye cream if it's really gonna work. This was a great buy. Would highly recommend.
This cream goes on smoothly and soaks into your skin. I would recommend this eye cream.
Waiting to see improvement in my fine lines but it has definitely helped with the dark circles and bags under my eyes
I notice a difference in the skin around my eye area after using this for several weeks. My skin is softer, less puffy, and hydrated. I have sensitive skin and this product has been well tolerated.

I'm in my late 50's. So I've have puffy eyes on a regular basis , this eye cream is light in feeling on the skin which is nice. Does it rid you of puffy eyes , no, but it's a nice cream I use it in conjunction with the eye sticks glow& get . I've used this product combo for over 60days. Shipping was slow so if you need it fast plan accordingly.
I suffer from allergies and extreme eyelid dryness. The Tula revitalizing eye cream is part of my morning and night regimen, very rich and moisturizing. Love it!
It's lightweight and non-greasy. Perfect moisturizer for any season.

Great texture and moisture. Use cream in morning and night. A little goes long way. I prefer products in this type container, can see when getting low, no waste of product. Will definitely purchase again. I recommend this product line to daughter and she's now a customer.

I have tried to use this a couple times. I wanted to make sure my issues were from this eye cream. Most definitely is the cause of my dry, peeling, and burning skin. I had high hopes because of the price tag. I ended up with even more sensitive skin.

I did not find this eye cream to be anything special, though luckily I didn't suffer some of the issues others have noted. It didn't feel as silky or luxurious as other eye creams I've used and it also didn't provide a high level of moisture. I'm not keen on potted creams, ingredients break down and it's not quite as sanitary as a closed dispenser, but based on the positive reviews, I gave it a shot. After several months of usage, it didn't improve the skin around my eyes, but at the same time didn't make anything worse, so middle of the road.

avis.titre: I definitely buy this product again
avis.texte: Tula is an amazing skin care line wished she had more samples

avis.titre: Created dry under eye skin, never had before
avis.texte: By the third day of using this morning and night I began to notice dry scaly skin under my eyes. I have never had this before and have used other Tula products with no issues. Will be returning due to reaction.

I bought this eye cream at the recommendation of 2 ulta associates based on my incredibly sensitive skin due to retinol usage (even though I don't use it around my eye area). Every time I've used it my skin burns, itches, and becomes inflamed. I realized there is alcohol in this product, too, which ended up drying out my skin and making it crepe-y. Don't recommend at all. Would have returned but I threw away the packaging!

So, I used to use Clinique eye cream which was great but it was very thick and oily as well as a little hard on my eyes. I decided to try this, as I already love my other Tula products. I was a little skeptical at first because it's not as thick and oily, only for it to turn out that it makes it so much better. This eye cream is so moisturizing without the residue, and it is amazing for sensitive skin. A little goes a very long way. For reference, I have very dry, very oily combination skin that is sensitive and prone to acne. This makes my eyes look and feel great. I will continue to use this product. It is worth the price, to me anyway.
I see major improvement in the darkness under my eyes since using this eye cream
So far so good. I have been using the eye cream for a couple of weeks now. I have not had any problems with eye irritation. I like the way it feels. I will purchase again.

This eye cream does not rub into my skin nicely, it leaves like a thin white layer which is why I will opt for a different eye cream when I run out. Also, if it gets too close to my eye, the scent makes my eyes burn. I do NOT recommend this product.

I didn't believe this eye cream was supposed to do everything it claimed to do, but I tried it anyways. I tried and tried it, made the skin around my eyes dry, red, and swollen! I've never had this type of reaction to an eye cream before. This is my fifth Tula product that I've purchased/sampled and I'm disappointed with the WHOLE line! Waste of time and money.

This eye cream leaves the skin around my eyes feeling nourished and and supple. The only thing I would change-I'm not a fan of the scent. I would prefer it to have no scent, or a scent similar to the Protect & Plump facial moisturizer.
I would love to see a better direction how to use you're product, sometimes it's hard to read the directions…
So far I really like this eye cream. Very moisturizing. Love the jar dispenser too, you get the perfect amount each time. Def worth a try!
Love this stuff! Creamy and smells so clean. I love the whole line!

I made the switch to Tula and really needed a new eye cream. Initially I was against the eye sticks because the thought of dragging the skin was against everything I was taught, so i went with the revitalizing eye cream. Though this product is moisturizing, I didn't see any firming benefits or improvements in lines by the end of the first container. I've since switched to the brightening stick, and I LOVE it. It was my fault for buying a second container before testing it, as I now have a second container that I won't be using.
Love this product. It works great and isn't irritating like other eye products have been for me in the past. I've paired it with other Tula products and now a huge fan of the brand
I saw a difference in the skin around my eyes within a month of using this eye cream. I have now used it for over 2 years and still love it!

I didn't use all jar yet. For now I can say cream is good, I don't have allergies or pink eye, it's very important to me! My eyes are well moisturized, wrinkles less visible. No changes in sagging eye lids.
I used for quite a while and I didn't really notice any difference or improvement with my under eyes. Disappointing.

Have had this since February (2022) and don't notice a difference. Only good thing is it hasn't irritated my undereye area! Everyone's skin different and it may work for others and they see a difference, but not me!

avis.titre: Worth it! Give it a try
avis.texte: I waited until the jar was almost finished before leaving a review. This product is LEGIT. I love the results! My under eye area seems to have fewer lines and looks more plump. Goes on smooth, not greasy. Works great under makeup.

I've been using this about a week so far. The texture and blend is amazing. I don't notice a lot of decrease in fine lines yet but it probably takes a few weeks to see those type of results. My eyes definitely do not look as tired in the morning after using this.

I love this stuff! I was having trouble with severe dryness under my eyes and it was making my concealer look terrible! But this stuff moisturizes my eyes so well and they are not longer dry! I love the subtle smell and the way it makes me look more awake!

avis.titre: Worked for my dry patch of skin on eye

I've tried so many different brands, even more expensive ones than this and had to end up returning them. I had switched to another eye cream that seemed to be working for a few months but the dry patch came back so here I am back with Tula which instantly helped. The eye cream is pricey but a little really goes a long way.
I absolutely love this eye cream! It feels amazing and I can tell a difference!
I love this eye cream! I have tried many eye creams, but have not found one worth sticking with until this one. It goes on great, and I can really see a difference in the skin around my eyes.
I use this eye cream at night. I love it, it's so moisturizing!
Feels really great on my skin. I feel like it's super moisturizing and my skin already looks better!

The eye cream is so very nice. Does not clump or crease. Is smooth & light and the jar is a great size. I use day & night and isn't irritating
Love this eye cream! Does not irritate my skin at all. I've been using this for 2 weeks now and can see a difference already!
The eye cream has been a great addition to my skincare regime.

Great eye cream. Light weight and good quality. Can only wear it at night though as it needs some time to soak in. When applying in the morning I find my waterproof eyeliner doesn't stay on due to the residue / sheen of the eye cream….because I don't have time to let it soak in before applying makeup.

avis.titre: Haven't noticed any changes yet, but haven't been using it l
avis.texte: I haven't been using this for long, maybe only 2 weeks, so I probably need to give it more time, but I haven't noticed a big difference in the skin around my eye area. I still have puffiness in the mornings, for which I usually put on caffeine eye patches… but I'm going to give it more time because I do like this product and think I just need to increase my frequency of use!
